mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates exceeding 5.5% indicate persistent labor market weakness that suppresses corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with UNRATE > 5.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS below 0.1% and rising CPIAUCSL above 0.2% MoM signals policy accommodation amid inflation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through joint market expectations.
failure_condition: The joint condition (FEDFUNDS<=0.1% and CPIAUCSL MoM>=0.2%) produces negative S&P 500 returns in more than 60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In early recovery phases (UNRATE > 5.5% with INDPRO growth > 0.3% MoM), strengthening manufacturing output amid high unemployment signals economic stabilization, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of early recovery periods (UNRATE>5.5% and INDPRO growth>0.3% MoM), or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts above the 12-month moving average signal strengthening consumer demand and economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with HOUST above 12-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production declining more than 0.5% MoM indicates manufacturing contraction, suppressing corporate profits and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO decline >0.5% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales growth exceeding 0.5% MoM signals robust consumer spending that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with RSAFS growth >0.5% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%) combined with low policy rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals sustained accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods meeting CPIAUCSL<2.0% and FEDFUNDS<0.5%, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.
